t: Help with purchasing tickets for Switzerland online | SBB help & contact
s: To use a coupon code when making a purchase online at SBB.ch, enter it directly in the ‘Coupon’ field during payment. Start your connection enquiry via the timetable. Select the connection you want and click on ‘Tickets from CHF xx.xx’. Once you have made your selection, click ‘Continue’. Log in or purchase as a guest without logging in and click on ‘Continue’. Enter your voucher code under ‘Means of payment’ and click ‘Buy now’.
